connect.title: Connect to Yoda
connect.intro: Paste the Yoda address shown on Yoda's Help page and press Connect, then approve on the page that opens.

error.insecure: It must be https (or http://localhost for testing)
error.permission_needed: Allow the extension to reach this Yoda first
error.not_yoda: This address is not a Yoda
error.extension_disabled: The extension is turned off in this Yoda
error.state_mismatch: The connection did not match the request; try again
error.unreachable: Cannot reach Yoda; check the address or the network

options.subtitle: Each profile is one Yoda you connected. A report goes to the profile and project that match the page you are on.
options.sessionOnly: Sign out when the browser closes
options.noRules: No rules yet. Yoda sends the URLs of its projects; add your own for local or test sites.
options.testerNone: No rule matches: you pick the project in the popup
options.rulesInfo: "From Yoda" rules come from each project's application URLs and GitLab environments, refreshed when you open the popup. "Policy" rules come from IT through Chrome or Edge policy and cannot be changed here.
options.privacyHint: Granted when you connected a Yoda or started capture on a site. Remove any you no longer need.

editor.draftMissing: This draft is gone: it was sent, or it is older than 24 hours.
editor.burnedIn: Blur, mosaic and redact are burned into the image; the original is never sent. Nothing is hidden automatically.
editor.videoDropped: The clip was discarded: during the recording the tab went to a page that is production or could not be checked. Report with a screenshot instead.

review.title: Check before sending
review.hint: Screenshots and logs from hospital systems may contain patient data. Send only what the fix needs.
review.production: This is a production site: no video, and logs only when turned on.
review.confirm: I checked the screenshot and video: there is no patient data, or it is hidden with mosaic or redact
review.sensitive: The text may contain patient data (the text is not sent to AI)
review.aiText: AI may read the text; screenshots, video and logs never

report.title: Title
report.priorityHint: Suggested priority "{p}"; the project manager can change it in Yoda
report.buildSource: Detected from {s}; you can edit it
report.buildNone: No build found; you can type it
report.includeQuery: Include URL query strings (the page and the logs)
report.noProfile: The Yoda this draft belongs to is not connected
report.sessionFailed: Cannot reach Yoda; the draft is kept, try again later
report.reconnectText: Reconnect to Yoda; your draft is kept

error.tooLarge: A file is too large; remove a file
error.type: A file has a type Yoda does not take
error.videoOnProduction: No video from production sites; remove the video
error.network: Sending failed (network); the draft is kept, try again
error.other: Sending failed; the draft is kept
error.mosaicNotApplied: Apply the mosaic to the video first, or untick the video

popup.notConnected: Not connected to a Yoda yet
popup.unreachable: Cannot reach Yoda; check the network
popup.update: A newer extension ({v}) is on Yoda's Help page
popup.tooOld: This extension is too old for this Yoda; please update

stoppedReason.injection_failed: the page does not allow it

error.arm: Cannot capture logs on this page
error.tabChanged: The tab changed during the capture; stay on the page and try again
error.permission_needed: Allow tab recording to make a video
error.unknown_page: This page cannot be checked against Yoda's production sites (not reachable, or the address cannot be read), so no video

video.title: Mosaic on video
video.hint: Drag on the video to cover an area with mosaic, then set its time range. Apply burns it into the clip.
video.keepVisible: Keep this tab visible while the mosaic is applied
video.paused: Paused: this tab is hidden. It continues when the tab is visible again.
video.applied: The mosaic is burned into the video
video.pending: Apply the mosaic before sending, or untick the video
video.failedTitle: The mosaic could not be applied to the video
video.failedText: The video is never sent with the regions unapplied. Send the report without the video, or use one still frame with the regions hidden.
